description: Free, never charged: how to write a custom nanoodle workflow graph for run_noodle — the node types this server runs (inputs, outputs, key fields), the wiring rules, a complete example graph, hosted NanoGPT model candidates with their unit prices, and local slice-3d and sprite-stack-render wiring. Filter with `kind`, `node_type`, `search` (model ID substring) and `limit`. Use `format_only` to skip catalog reads. Then check the estimated cost with price_noodle before calling run_noodle.

format_only.description: Return the graph format, rules and example without looking up models.

kind.description: Only list models of this kind.

node_type.description: Look up a node and limit model candidates to its catalog. Local sprite nodes have no model catalog.

search.description: Only list models whose id contains this text.

name: noodle_guide
